data.name: Elumah
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic root 'alama', meaning 'to promise'. In Islamic context, Elumah signifies the promise and assurance given by Allah (SWT) to His believers. It also represents the concept of unwavering commitment and loyalty towards Allah.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of Allah's promises and our commitment to fulfilling His commandments.
